name: Sakurayu
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood public bathhouse: an opening-hours notice, a first day helping at the front desk, a seasonal bathing-fee price list with a point-card bonus, a towel-rental service notice, a new-staff training comparison, a story about noticing a regular customer's change through good service, a trainee lesson on front-desk duties and water-temperature management, an explainer on why the Mt. Fuji mural keeps getting repainted, a sauna-set application guide, a column on how more solo visitors changed the bathhouse's day, a busy-season usage rule, a column on the meaning of a bathhouse's water-temperature craft, and a one-year bathhouse-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
